title.zh: Perpetuals com拟借SEC「创新豁免」推出美股代币化交易
title.en: Perpetuals com拟借SEC「创新豁免」推出美股代币化交易

current_state.zh: Perpetuals com (PDC) filed notice to run tokenized U.S. equity trading via permissioned AMM pools on its Kronos X Public L2 with USDC pairs under the SEC's five-year 'innovation exemption', with trading earliest in mid-November, making it the second firm after OKXICE to pursue the framework.
